title: VibeDeck workflow
description: A named state machine over VibeDeck agents, commands and skills: the first step is the start and each step's transitions decide the next one from its verdict or result (loops allowed) until none applies. Lives at <repo>/.vibedeck/workflows/<slug>.json.

input.description: What to ask for when starting it (e.g. <PR number>).

maxSteps.description: Most step runs per execution (guard against endless loops; default 25).

steps.description: Steps in order; the first one is the start.

id.description: Key unique inside the workflow, used by transitions.

ref.description: Slug of a VibeDeck agent/command/skill, never the AI provider's.

note.description: Extra instruction for the step ($ARGUMENTS for commands).

maxVisits.description: Most runs of this step per execution cycle; exceeding it stops the run.

transitions.description: Verdicts first, then conditions, then the fallback; none = end.

verdict.description: Exact last line of the step's result (case and accents ignored); checked before `when`.

when.description: Natural-language condition judged on the result; with neither verdict nor when = always (fallback).

to.description: Id of a step of this workflow (earlier steps allowed).
